sources.claim: Independent review permits internal acceptance within its stated scope.

assumptions: Acceptance is limited to the internal scope recorded in the review.

criteria: No unauthorized runner, sends or production changes
No exposed private records or fake running metrics
Schemas, records and job lifecycle agree
Find material gaps and required next steps
retest_conditions: Material changes to reviewed artifact or its evidence require review.
coverage_limits: Exact coverage and hashes in the independent review.
